title: Slovakian Beef and Dumplings
description: A hearty, comforting dish from Slovakia featuring tender beef and fluffy dumplings in a rich, savory broth.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Add flour to pot and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth, whisking constantly.
Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add beef back to pot and cook until tender, about 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook dumplings according to package instructions or make homemade.
Add cooked dumplings to pot and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Season with paprika and serve hot.
